decisions.publication_scope: internal school archive only (restricted OralHistory drive; not public website)

commitments.detail: Approval file must include a training-verification record confirming that each of the eight approved interviewers (J1, J3, J6, J8, J11, J14, J17, J20) has completed the district's media-ethics training before any interviews begin.

A consent-exclusion record must be included documenting that interviewees I2, I5, I9, I14, and I18 have not granted permission for public web publication and their recordings may be used only in the school's internal archive.

A secure-storage configuration record must be included documenting that recordings will use district tablets, be stored in the restricted OralHistory drive, not be published on the public website, and be deleted exactly 45 days after the final class presentation.

Only the eight students who have completed media-ethics training are approved to conduct interviews; the remaining 12 students may not serve as interviewers until they complete the required training and submit verification records.
